title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.29697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive

translated_title: 事实核查错误产生于何处？在基于证据的验证中分离检索、搜索控制与判断
translated_abstract: 基于证据的事实核查器可能因找不到证据而失败，也可能因没有使用证据而失败；端到端的准确率无法区分这两种情况。我们提出了一套协议，追踪参考证据从存储库到最终裁决的完整路径，将检索、搜索控制、判断和裁决验证四个环节分离开来。我们使用一个开放权重的9B模型，在两种证据条件下评估了来自FEVER、FEVER 2.0和AVeriTeC的293条声明：一种是标注证据的小型存储库（证据发现较为容易），另一种是完整的源文档集合。在对照条件下，单次混合检索即可为228条含证据声明中的226条提供完整的参考证据，而自适应控制器和工具智能体花费了二到九倍的模型调用次数，却没有带来一致的性能提升。在34条被标记为缺乏证据的决定性声明中，有33条的证据包中实际包含完整证据：其中15条是判断器选择弃权，另外18条是验证规则推翻了决定性……
tldr: 该论文提出一套分离检索、搜索控制、判断与裁决验证的诊断协议，发现事实核查失败的主要根源不在证据检索（单次混合检索即可覆盖绝大多数声明的完整证据），而在于证据的后续使用环节——判断器弃权与验证规则推翻了本可正确作出的裁决。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diagnostic protocol separating retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation, showing that fact-checking failures stem mainly from the evidence-use stage (judge abstention and validation rules overturning correct verdicts) rather than retrieval, since a single hybrid retrieval pass already recovers complete evidence for nearly all claims.
